SELECT
	Doctype = 'SV-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SL.SALEINVCODE, 10))), 
	SL.DATE, 
	Type='S', 
	InvCode=SL.SaleInvCode,
	ItemCode=SD.ICode, 
	AliasName=I.CustomICode, 
	Item=I.Name, 
	CustomerAlias=A.AliasName,
	Customer=A.Name,
	Patientname = (SELECT P.Name FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = SL.PatientCode), 
	Qty=SUM(SD.LooseQty),
	Bonus=SUM(SD.BonusQty),
	RetQty=0,
	RetBonus=0,
	Area=AR.Name,
	Rate = ROUND(I.SalePrice / CASE I.PackUnits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PackUnits END, 2),
	Packing=I.PackingDesc,
	price= max(SD.saleprice),
	discval= Round(Sum (Round(( SD.looseqty  * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc) * (SD.discperc * .01)) + (SD.looseqty  * SD.itemflatdisc),2)), 2) + Round(Sum ( SD.looseqty   * (SD.saleprice  - SD.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (SD.discperc * .01))) * (max(SL.discperc) /100), 2)
FROM
	SaleLedger SL, SaleDetail SD, Accounts A, Customer C, Area AR, Item I
WHERE
	:ai_allitems = 0 AND
	SL.Date BETWEEN :ar_StartDate AND :ar_EndDate AND
	SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
	SL.CustCode = C.CustCode AND 
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	SD.ICode IN (:ar_ICode) AND
	SD.ICode =  I.ICode AND
	C.AreaCode = AR.AreaCode
GROUP BY
	SL.SaleInvCode,
	SD.ICode, 
	I.Name, 
	I.CustomICode,
	SD.SalePrice,
	I.SalePrice,
	I.PackUnits,
	I.PackingDesc,
	SL.DATE,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name, 
	SL.PatientCode,
	AR.Name
UNION ALL
